project_name: MikiLab Mobile-First Web App - Cleaned Italian & German Artisan Design System
target_audience: Professional & Amateur Bakers, Pastry Chefs, Pizzerias & Multi-store Food Businesses in Italy & Germany
owner: Michele, Italian baker working in Germany

core_design_philosophy.concept: Calm Italian & German Artisan Fusion ('Mantieni colori calmi ma aggiungi colori italiani e tedeschi come ordine primario')
core_design_philosophy.tagline: Unica al mondo, semplice, senza tempo
core_design_philosophy.owner_directive: Eliminare i doppioni nella navigazione e rendere l'interfaccia coerente, ordinata e pulita.
key_principles: No Navigation Duplication: Main tab destinations (Home, Ricette, Il Tuo Laboratorio, Impara, Community) live permanently in the BottomNav. Do NOT repeat them as large redundant callout cards inside Home.
Clean Visual Hierarchy: Structure the Home page strictly in top-down storytelling and functional tiers.
Calm IT+DE Cultural Palette: Muted Sage Green (#5E8B7E, #33564E), Terracotta Red (#A64B2A, #B34A26), Sourdough Gold (#C88A2B), German Charcoal (#1E1B18), Flour Cream (#F6F8F5).
Signature IT/DE Flag Ribbon: Subtle 3px top micro-ribbon (.it-de-ribbon) representing Italian & German artisan heritage.
Non-Transparent Backdrop Surfaces: All headers, modals, popovers, and bottom bars MUST use non-transparent backdrops (bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1B2127]/90 with backdrop-blur-md).
FAB Spacing & Collision Prevention: Floating Action Buttons (Radio & Parla/Voice) positioned at bottom-20 z-40, with pb-32 main container padding so no content is obscured.

home_cleanup_blueprint.objective: Riordino completo della Home SENZA doppioni di navigazione con la BottomNav, organizzata in 7 blocchi sequenziali ad alta gerarchia visiva.
eliminated_duplicates: Rimosse card duplicati 'Per professionisti' (stessa destinazione del tab 'Il Tuo Laboratorio')
Rimosse card duplicati 'Per chi inizia' (stessa destinazione del tab 'Impara')
Rimosse card duplicati 'Ricette' ed 'Esplora MikiLab' redundanti con il tab 'Ricette'
Rimosse card duplicati 'Community' redundanti con il tab 'Community'

ordered_home_sections.description: Avatar video parlante di Michele in alto con nastro IT/DE, bolla di testo animata e tasto Play.
Dashboard benvenuto con livello/XP del panettiere e scorciatoie contestuali rapide (Ricette, Focus, Attrezzatura).
Griglia pulita 'Strumenti & Risorse MikiLab' dedicata ESCLUSIVAMENTE alle destinazioni non presenti nella barra in basso: News, Enciclopedia del Pane, Diagnosi Foto IA, Enterprise Multi-Negozio.
Card tattica ad alto impatto 'Chiedi al Maestro' per avviare la chat assistente IA.
Sezione fisarmonica richiudibile 'Scopri MikiLab' (Chi è Michele, Il Metodo, Filosofia, Serenità, Firma tattoo e battuta del giorno).
Modulo in fondo 'MikiLab Shop & Corsi' con tab 'Shop Ricette' (attivo) e 'Corsi Online' (in arrivo a breve).
Install banner PWA, pulsante condivisione app e note legali in pie' di pagina.

color_system.description: Palette artigianale mista italo-tedesca con toni calmi, accenti legnosi e dorati della fermentazione.

fab_layout_strategy.description: Gestione dei pulsanti flottanti (Radio Fornaio & Voice Assistant/Parla) per evitare sovrapposizioni e coperture di testo.

radio_fab.icon: Radio icon with equalizer animation when playing

voice_fab.icon: Mic icon with pulsing border when listening

fab_layout_strategy.container_padding: main content MUST have pb-32 sm:pb-28 to allow bottom scrolling above FABs and BottomNav

tiers.tier_1_standard: bg-white dark:bg-[#1F252B] border border-[#D7E1DB] dark:border-[#38424B] shadow-sm rounded-3xl p-5
tiers.tier_2_accent: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#5E8B7E] to-[#33564E] text-white shadow-lg rounded-3xl p-5
tiers.tier_3_glass: backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F6F8F5]/95 dark:bg-[#1B2127]/95 border border-[#D7E1DB] dark:border-[#38424B] shadow-xl rounded-2xl p-4
tiers.tier_4_tactical: bg-[#1E1B18] text-white border-l-4 border-l-[#C88A2B] shadow-xl rounded-3xl p-5

general_rules: Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g. data-testid='home-quick-ricette').
Header, Dropdown, BottomNav, and Floating Panels MUST NOT use fully transparent backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 or bg-[#1B2127]/90.
Use sonner for toast notifications across all user actions.

Header_js.styling: Sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F6F8F5]/95 dark:bg-[#1B2127]/95 border-b border-[#D7E1DB] dark:border-[#38424B] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between

BottomNav_js.styling: Fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F6F8F5]/95 dark:bg-[#1B2127]/95 border-t border-[#D7E1DB] dark:border-[#38424B] px-2 py-2 grid grid-cols-5 max-w-xl mx-auto

Home_js.styling: Mobile-first centered max-w-xl mx-auto space-y-6 pb-2

prioritized_rollout_order.title: Home Page De-duplication & Clean Blueprint Alignment
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Remove duplicate cards for Ricette, Impara, Maestro, and Community. Create dedicated non-bottom destinations grid (News, Enciclopedia, Diagnosi, Enterprise).

prioritized_rollout_order.title: FAB Positioning & Container Bottom Padding
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Ensure Radio and Voice FABs sit cleanly at bottom-20 z-40, and main scroll area uses pb-32 sm:pb-28 to eliminate content clipping.

prioritized_rollout_order.title: BottomNav & Header Backdrop Non-Transparency Verification
prioritized_rollout_order.action: Ensure backdrop-blur with opaque fill bg-[#F6F8F5]/95 and dark:bg-[#1B2127]/95 is consistently enforced with full data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json completely before modifying any section.
Strictly enforce data-testid attributes on all interactive buttons, cards, and tabs.
Never delete functionality or routes; reorganize the Home section to eliminate duplicates with the bottom navbar.
Maintain the existing calm sage green, terracotta, sourdough gold, and charcoal palette with .it-de-ribbon details.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: All buttons, inputs, tabs, recipe items, language switchers, and dialog actions MUST retain or add data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header or overlay dropdown backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_library: Use sonner for user feedback toasts.
